title: Should You Buy the Vanguard Information Technology ETF During the Nasdaq Correction? History Offers a Clear Answer
title_zh: 您应该在纳斯达克调整期间购买先锋信息技术 ETF 吗？历史给出了明确的答案
summary: The recent broad market sell-off is giving investors a chance to buy high-growth technology stocks at a discount.
summary_zh: 最近的大盘抛售给投资者提供了以折扣价购买高增长科技股的机会。

title: As a Direct Challenge to Starlink, Amazon and Delta Are Teaming Up to Offer In-Flight Wi-Fi. Which Stock Will Benefit the Most?
title_zh: 作为对 Starlink 的直接挑战，亚马逊和达美航空正在联手提供机上 Wi-Fi。哪只股票将受益最多？
summary: Amazon's Delta deal could unlock a powerful new revenue stream, though execution will remain the key deciding factor.
summary_zh: 亚马逊与达美航空的交易可以释放强大的新收入来源，但执行仍将是关键的决定因素。

title: KKR Balances Credit Fund Redemptions With PolyPeptide Deal Ambitions
title_zh: KKR 平衡信贷基金赎回与多肽交易雄心
summary: KKR is facing a wave of investor redemption requests in its private credit funds, prompting withdrawal limits similar to those seen at other large asset managers.
summary_zh: KKR 的私人信贷基金正面临一波投资者赎回请求，这导致了与其他大型资产管理公司类似的提款限制。

title: SpaceX Is Going Public. Why a Tesla Merger Could Be Musk’s Real Endgame.
title_zh: SpaceX 即将上市。为什么特斯拉的合并可能是马斯克真正的结局。
summary: SpaceX’s initial public offering may be the largest IPO ever, but it might just be a prelude to the largest merger ever—a combination of  Tesla  with Elon Musk’s space venture. On April 1, SpaceX reportedly filed confidentially for an IPO.
summary_zh: SpaceX 的首次公开募股可能是有史以来最大规模的 IPO，但这可能只是有史以来最大的合并（特斯拉与埃隆·马斯克的太空企业合并）的前奏。据报道，4 月 1 日，SpaceX 秘密提交了 IPO 申请。

title: Cloudflare Sell-Off Offers Buying Opportunity as Project Glasswing Concerns 'Overblown,' Oppenheimer Says
title_zh: 奥本海默表示，由于 Glasswing 项目担心“言过其实”，Cloudflare 的抛售提供了买入机会
summary: Cloudflare's (NET) stock sell-off offers a buying opportunity, while concerns around Project Glasswi
summary_zh: Cloudflare (NET) 的股票抛售提供了买入机会，同时对 Project Glasswi 的担忧
